name: Green's Propagator for Participating Media
definition: The Green's propagator G is the solution to the homogeneous version of the radiative transfer equation (source term set to zero) with an initial condition defined by a Dirac delta function representing a point source at position x' and direction ω'.
summary: Green's Propagator is the fundamental solution to the radiative transfer equation, separating transport physics from source terms to enable iterative light transport solutions in participating media.
